test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**able**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence context is about being capable or having the capacity to control one's emotions while driving on the road.
 
• The word "**able**" fits perfectly as it suggests the capability or capacity to do something, which in this context is controlling one's emotions.
 
• Other options such as "**consistent**", "**oblige**", and "**brave**" do not directly relate to the aspect of controlling emotions or responses in stressful driving conditions.
 
• The word "able" implies a sense of control and choice, which is central to managing road rage and maintaining calm under potentially aggravating circumstances.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Correct paragraph: All drivers are affected by road rage, whether they are directly or indirectly involved__ Individual coping qualities __influence__ the behaviour of stressful drivers. Instead of being enraged over circumstances beyond their control, drivers __must__ learn to be patient. On the road, we must be **__able__** to control our own emotions. Road raged drivers are also more likely to ______ (5) _______ more traffic offences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Oblige: **to compel or bind morally or legally to a course of action. (किसी कार्यवाही के लिए नैतिक या कानूनी रूप से बाध्य करना)
 
• **Able: **indicates having the capability or capacity to do something, rather than the consistency or effort required to maintain control over one's emotions. (किसी की भावनाओं पर नियंत्रण बनाए रखने के लिए आवश्यक निरंतरता या प्रयास के बजाय कुछ करने की क्षमता या क्षमता होने का संकेत मिलता है)
 
• **Brave: **showing courage or fearlessness in facing difficult or dangerous situations. (कठिन या खतरनाक परिस्थितियों का सामना करने में साहस या निडरता दिखाना)
